muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is mobility plus exclusive territory with alpha-beta search. Queen mobility counts one-step queen reach, exclusive reach counts empty squares reachable by only one side, centralisation breaks ties. All moves are ordered by this static score and searched with iterative deepening, alpha-beta pruning and width limits to fit in 1s. The root keeps the best completed depth and always falls back to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is mobility plus king-distance territory with phase weighting and selective 2-ply search. All queen rays are precomputed for fast move generation. Every own full move is evaluated statically, ordered, then the top candidates are verified against the opponent best reply ordered by arrow proximity to our amazons with alpha-beta cutoffs. Immediate wins are taken, time is guarded to always return a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/003: Strategy is 2-ply minimax with strong Amazons evaluation. Mobility (queen-reachable squares and trapped amazons) plus territory by queen-move distance in the opening and king-move distance in the endgame, with phase-dependent weights. All moves are generated queen-like with the vacated square treated as empty for the arrow. Moves are ordered by a fast king-territory evaluation, top candidates are searched with full alpha-beta cutoffs for opponent best reply, immediate wins are taken, and time is strictly managed with a safe fallback to always return a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is mobility plus territory search with time control. Queen reach counts give short term freedom, king-distance BFS gives long term enclosure, weighted by empty squares to favour mobility early and territory late. All moves are generated with bitboards and precomputed rays, ordered by own remaining mobility plus blocking of opponent reachable squares, then searched with negamax alpha-beta and iterative deepening. Depth 1 evaluates every move, deeper depths keep only top ordered moves to stay inside 1s, always keeping a legal fallback.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is mobility plus king-distance territory with phase weighting and selective minimax. Queen-move counts measure freedom, multi-source king BFS measures secure territory, centralisation is a small tie-break. Immediate wins when the opponent has zero queen moves are prioritized. All full moves are generated queen-like for both the amazon step and the arrow with the vacated square treated as empty, 1-ply static scores order the moves, then a time-limited alpha-beta search refines the choice: selective 2-ply with arrow-proximity ordering and truncation for large branching, full 3-4 ply with iterative deepening for small endgame branching. Aggressive move ordering, early cutoffs and strict time checks guarantee a legal move within 1s.
